alice-support: Hi team — customer reports tool call schema validation error when sending image bytes via the TypeScript SDK; Python client OK. Error: 'invalid type for field image_data: expected string (base64)'. @ben-sdk can you take a look?
dan-customer: Repro steps: Node 18, ts-sdk 1.4.2. Minimal code: `const res = client.callTool('ocr', { image_data: fs.readFileSync('/tmp/img.jpg') })` — it fails. If I do `fs.readFileSync(...).toString('base64')` it succeeds. Also noticed extra padding when uploading from browser via fetch.
ben-sdk: Thx — can you paste the exact JSON payload that hits the wire (from inspector / tcpdump)? Also what's the tool schema definition for 'ocr'? :thinking_face:
alice-support: Here's the captured body from their Node run (copied from tcpdump):
```json
{"tool":"ocr","args":{"image_data":"\u0000\u0000\u0000\u0010��JFIF...\u0000\u0000"}}
```
(weird trailing \u0000 sequences and some binary residues). The Content-Type reported as `application/json`.
carla-eng: This matches a bug we've seen before — JSON.stringify on Buffer/TypedArray in Node contexts can produce `{}` and some code paths fall back to sending raw bytes or interpolating binary as escaped unicode, producing those nulls. Python SDK encodes bytes to base64 explicitly so it never hits this. :eyes:
ben-sdk: Ok repro'ed locally with Node + esm loader + fetch polyfill. When our serializer sees a Buffer it currently does `JSON.stringify(obj)` which yields `{}` for Buffer, and we then call our fallback that merges the Buffer into the JSON string incorrectly. Quick fix: detect Buffer / ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array / Blob / File and replace with `buf.toString('base64')` or `await blob.arrayBuffer()` -> base64. I'll prepare a patch.
emily-ml: Server-side note: tool schemas require `image_data` as base64 string per contract. We could consider relaxing the validation to accept raw bytes if content-type indicates `application/octet-stream` on an attachment field, but that complicates auditing and caching. Recommend SDK patch first, then revisit server tolerance if we see many clients.
ben-sdk: Pushed a branch with explicit serializer check + unit tests for Node + browser. Also handling File/Blob via `arrayBuffer()` then base64. Will bump to v1.4.3. Can someone sanity-check browser File case?
dan-customer: I tested v1.4.3 pre-release — Node case fixed. Browser case: original code used `readAsBinaryString` (old) which produced null padding when converted to base64 manually. With SDK using `file.arrayBuffer()` -> base64, it fixed it. Thanks!
deploy-bot: Published `ts-sdk@1.4.3` — patch notes: "Ensure Buffer/ArrayBuffer/Blob/File are base64-serialized for tool call args. Fixes schema validation failures when sending binary data." (commit abc123)
alice-support: Closing loop with customer, asked them to upgrade to 1.4.3. Marking as resolved unless they hit a follow-up. :thumbsup:
